E2822

`ui.asset("{path}")` names `{resolved}`, and there is no file there.

What

`ui.asset("{path}")` names `{resolved}`, and there is no file there.

Why

An asset path names a file from the calling file's own directory, as `embed_bytes` names one, and every target ships that file with the program; the path is checked while the program builds, so a path with no file would leave the image, font or icon missing on every target.

Fix

Put the file at `{resolved}`, or name a file that is there, relative to this file's directory.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2822: Tests/UI/web_build_missing_asset.stderr.
